description: Align the public CodeCamp Advantage page with the production curriculum, mastery, tutoring, media, APK, and guarded PR-review release, then deploy and verify the www site.
deviation_notes: The first two www Cloud Builds failed before Docker execution because the root .gcloudignore admitted only codecamp-advantage. Commit bd30da22 restored the www build context. The final Measure audit also added the promised cohort boundary and production toolchain before the successful immutable deployment.
